subject: Subject-01
accusation: Subject-01 secretly steered a public contract to a vendor in exchange for a personal kickback.
evidence: E1
The vendor received the highest score from a five-member blinded evaluation panel before Subject-01 saw the final ranking.
E2
Bank and disclosure records show no payment, gift, ownership interest, or family relationship between Subject-01 and the vendor.
E3
The procurement audit found the scoring record complete and found no unauthorized changes to bids or scores.
refutation: An independent procurement audit concluded that the kickback accusation was unsupported and inconsistent with the documentary record.
calm_defense: I did not steer this contract or receive anything from the vendor. The audit record shows what happened.
angry_defense: This accusation is outrageous. I did not steer this contract or receive anything from the vendor. The audit record shows what happened.

subject: Subject-02
accusation: Subject-02 used nonprofit funds to pay for a private vacation and disguised the charges as program expenses.
evidence: E1
The questioned airfare and lodging dates match a scheduled grant-funded field visit and the organization's travel calendar.
E2
Itemized receipts and card records show no companion ticket, leisure booking, or personal reimbursement request.
E3
An external accountant traced the charges to the approved grant budget and found no personal expenditure in the questioned transactions.
refutation: The external accounting review concluded that the vacation-fraud accusation was false on the reviewed transactions.
calm_defense: Those were program travel expenses, not a vacation. The receipts and grant records show that.
angry_defense: This is an absurd accusation. Those were program travel expenses, not a vacation. The receipts and grant records show that.

subject: Subject-03
accusation: Subject-03 copied a confidential customer file and leaked it outside the company.
evidence: E1
Access logs show Subject-03's account never opened or downloaded the leaked file.
E2
The file was exported by an automated service account from a server Subject-03 did not administer.
E3
Forensic timestamps place the export while Subject-03's credentials were disabled during scheduled leave.
refutation: The incident review concluded that Subject-03 did not access or export the leaked file.
calm_defense: I did not access or leak that file. The access and forensic logs establish that.
angry_defense: I am furious that this was pinned on me. I did not access or leak that file. The access and forensic logs establish that.

subject: Subject-04
accusation: Subject-04 copied a competitor's analysis and presented it as original work.
evidence: E1
Version-control history contains Subject-04's analysis, including the disputed passages, three weeks before the competitor document was published.
E2
The underlying calculations are derived from a public dataset and Subject-04's timestamped notebook reproduces them independently.
E3
The review found no access by Subject-04 to the competitor's private drafts or shared workspace.
refutation: The authorship review concluded that the plagiarism accusation was contradicted by the timestamped development record.
calm_defense: I wrote the analysis independently. The version history and notebook predate the other document.
angry_defense: Calling this plagiarism is insulting. I wrote the analysis independently. The version history and notebook predate the other document.

subject: Subject-05
accusation: Subject-05 rigged a hiring process so a close friend would receive the position.
evidence: E1
Applications were scored by a four-person panel before candidate identities were disclosed to Subject-05 for final interviews.
E2
The selected candidate ranked first on the panel's written score sheet before Subject-05 participated.
E3
Conflict-of-interest disclosures and contact records show no prior personal, family, or business relationship between Subject-05 and the selected candidate.
refutation: The hiring review concluded that the favoritism accusation was unsupported and that the candidate led the blinded scoring process.
calm_defense: I did not rig the search and I did not know the candidate personally. The panel record shows how the selection occurred.
angry_defense: This claim is infuriating. I did not rig the search and I did not know the candidate personally. The panel record shows how the selection occurred.

subject: Subject-06
accusation: Subject-06 fabricated a set of measurements after an experiment failed.
evidence: E1
The instrument automatically uploaded raw measurements to a read-only server as each run completed.
E2
Server hashes match the values used in the analysis and predate the accusation.
E3
A second researcher independently reran the assay from stored samples and obtained results within the prespecified tolerance.
refutation: The integrity review concluded that the fabrication accusation was inconsistent with the instrument logs, hashes, and independent rerun.
calm_defense: I did not fabricate these measurements. The instrument logs, hashes, and rerun are the record.
angry_defense: I am angry that my integrity is being attacked. I did not fabricate these measurements. The instrument logs, hashes, and rerun are the record.

subject: Subject-07
accusation: Subject-07 removed high-value inventory from the warehouse and falsified the count to hide the theft.
evidence: E1
Badge logs show Subject-07 left the site before the inventory movement occurred and did not re-enter that day.
E2
Camera records show the items were moved to a mislabeled internal pallet rather than removed from the facility.
E3
A recount recovered every questioned item and the inventory system audit found the discrepancy came from a duplicated location code.
refutation: The loss-prevention review concluded that no theft occurred and that Subject-07 did not move or falsify the questioned inventory.
calm_defense: I did not take the inventory or alter the count. The badge, camera, and recount records show that.
angry_defense: This accusation makes me furious. I did not take the inventory or alter the count. The badge, camera, and recount records show that.

subject: Subject-08
accusation: Subject-08 deliberately changed a production configuration to cause an outage after a dispute with management.
evidence: E1
The configuration change was generated by an automated dependency update job, not Subject-08's user account.
E2
Audit logs show Subject-08 had no production session during the deployment window.
E3
The incident review reproduced the outage from the automated change in a clean environment without any manual intervention.
refutation: The post-incident review concluded that the sabotage accusation was false and attributed the outage to the automated dependency update.
calm_defense: I did not make that production change. The audit logs and reproduction show it came from the automated job.
angry_defense: I am livid that this was called sabotage. I did not make that production change. The audit logs and reproduction show it came from the automated job.
